items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: I had Jack Willis. ... all those boys working with me. ... about Frog and Jack and them working with me.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know, when I went in there sometime, Willie Humphrey would be there with you. Do you remember that?

Well, I'm happy to play some chimes, which I mean he wouldn't ever mention that he played with such a small musician like me, you know. Many of them wouldn't. Yeah, but I was there. I remember. Yeah, but I know you know. Just like, you remember when I was working for Leroy, the first patio out in there on Boyfriend Street? Mm-hmm. And I had Frog, Tramore Man, Frog. I had Jack Willis. I have Kimball, the big clarinet player that died there. Sam Dutre. And all those boys working with me. But right now, they…
Are you any kin to George Williams? No, I'm not kin to George Williams. Did you ever know him?
